notes: All path bodies are hand-set approximations from the single successful views. No rendering, compilation, raster comparison, curve-extrema or other optional coordinate computation was performed.
Nested exact groups are identified by complete source spans in reading.tex; their parent excerpts already contain them, so complete source is not duplicated for each child.

B023-G11 owns every word and punctuation mark in the two-line corollary statement. B023-G09 owns the full word formée, the shared f/cup stroke, final union limit, S11 and the period. B023-G04 owns only the second a and the separate M01; on and en remain outside.
